import json, subprocess, urllib.parse

BASE = "https://api.box.com/2.0"

def get(path, params=None):
    url = BASE + path
    if params:
        url += "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    out = subprocess.run(["curl", "-s", "-H", "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>", url],
                         capture_output=True, text=True)
    if out.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"curl failed: {out.stderr}")
    return json.loads(out.stdout)

def folder_items(fid):
    entries = []
    offset = 0
    while True:
        d = get(f"/folders/{fid}/items", {"limit": 1000, "offset": offset})
        entries += d["entries"]
        if not d["entries"] or len(entries) >= d["total_count"]:
            break
        offset = len(entries)
    return entries

    nfiles = 0
    for e in folder_items(fid):

            size += e.get("size", 0)
            nfiles += 1
        elif e["type"] == "folder":
            s, n = total_size(e["id"])
            size += s
            nfiles += n
    return size, nfiles
